metadata.task_goal: Establish a current documented qualification for a cerebrospinal-fluid culture report using the patient, specimen, and laboratory records.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1301
The neurology team asks whether a preliminary cerebrospinal-fluid culture finding can be relayed as the current organism result. Reference: CSF-V3-1301.
files./workspace/ehr/current_record.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1301
The patient is under evaluation for fever and altered mental status. Cerebrospinal-fluid collection occurred at 06:55. Empiric treatment was documented before the laboratory culture update.
files./workspace/ehr/specimen_record.txt:
SPECIMEN RECORD
Culture accession CSF-443 was received at 07:12. At 13:40, the preliminary comment reads gram-positive rods in enrichment broth. The direct smear field is negative. A repeat lumbar collection has not been requested.
files./workspace/ehr/laboratory_note.txt:
LABORATORY NOTE
The identification field for CSF-443 is blank. The laboratory comments that enrichment-broth morphology is preliminary and the culture remains in workup. The collection tube count is complete and no specimen-label discrepancy is recorded. A microbiology review contact is available.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace contains clinical context, specimen chain information, and a microbiology report in progress. Report language, method, and finality may differ across materials.
